coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 6 ground-truth variable categories: Docta label cleaning, raw versus Docta-cleaned training data, and F1-based predictive performance.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed Anthropic Harmless and Red Team datasets with generic classification datasets. Uses a fixed DeBERTa architecture instead of varying BERT and GPT-2. Treats ChatGPT and humans as label validators rather than evaluating model performance on the ChatGPT Cleaned and Human Sampled test subsets. Adds unsupported baselines and credibility metrics, and omits the toxicity-specific and Tables 6–7 context.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that Docta-cleaned training data should yield significantly higher F1-scores on both evaluation subsets, supporting improved label credibility through mitigation of raw-label inconsistencies.
